newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Jan 17.

text.p: Companies providing Personal Handyphone System (PHS) services plan to cut their long-distance call fees by 30 percent and abolish the initial contract fee in February. Leading providers of cellular phone services, including NTT Mobile Communications Network Inc (NTT Do Co Mo), also plan to cut their base charges in February. The DDI Pocket Telephone and Astel groups are expected to follow suit.

Three paperboard makers -- Rengo Co Ltd, Tomoku Co Ltd and Settsu Corp -- are expecting bigger pre-tax profits in the year to March, thanks to strong sales and production streamlining. But three other paperboard makers -- Sanko Paper Mfg Co Ltd, Chuo Paperboard Co Ltd and Takasaki Paper Manufacturing Co Ltd -- are expecting poor results due to a fall in cardboard prices and a rise in prices of fuel oil and other imported materials.
